name: Brannic Stonefist
ability_1_desc: If Brannic Stonefist moves at least 4 spaces before attacking on his turn, he adds 1 to his Attack Value for each attack he makes this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Brannic Stonefist rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, he adds 1 automatic shield to his defense roll.
design_note: A 6-life, attack-5 melee brick with a conditional +1 attack and a near-permanent +1 defense sits awkwardly between mid-tier bruisers and premium champions.

name: Brannic Stonefist (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Brannic Stonefist (variant) moves at least 4 spaces before attacking on his turn, he adds 1 to his Attack Value for each attack he makes this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Brannic Stonefist (variant) rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, he adds 1 automatic shield to his defense roll.
ability_3_desc: When Brannic Stonefist (variant) attacks, he must attack the figure that is nearest to him, counting clear sight spaces, whether that figure is an opponent's figure or a figure you control. If two or more figures are equally near, you may choose which of those figures he attacks. Brannic Stonefist (variant) may not be moved so that a figure you control is the nearest figure only to avoid attacking an opponent's figure.
design_note: Forced targeting of friendlies is crippling in a crowded melee army but nearly free in a solo-hero build, so the discount depends entirely on assumed army context.

name: Seraphine Vael
ability_1_desc: All figures you control that are adjacent to Seraphine Vael add 1 to their Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent attacking figure.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Vael's movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine Vael may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine Vael starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying plus range 5, attack 4 and a friendly defensive aura stack into a support-and-damage package whose aura value swings wildly with squad count.

name: Seraphine Vael (variant)
ability_1_desc: All figures you control that are adjacent to Seraphine Vael (variant) add 1 to their Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent attacking figure.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Vael (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine Vael (variant) may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine Vael (variant) starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: Seraphine Vael (variant) cannot move and attack in the same turn. After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you must choose to either move with Seraphine Vael (variant) or attack with Seraphine Vael (variant), but not both.
design_note: A ranged hero loses less from 'no move and attack' than a melee one, and her aura still works on a move-only turn, making the drawback softer than it reads.

name: Thrax Hollowspine
ability_1_desc: Each time Thrax Hollowspine destroys an opponent's figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Thrax Hollowspine cannot Soul Harvest destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When Thrax Hollowspine rolls defense dice against a special attack, he adds 1 automatic shield to his defense roll.
design_note: Life 7 with defense 5, self-healing and extra shields against special attacks creates an attrition profile that is far tougher than its raw damage output suggests.

name: Thrax Hollowspine (variant)
ability_1_desc: Each time Thrax Hollowspine (variant) destroys an opponent's figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Thrax Hollowspine (variant) cannot Soul Harvest destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When Thrax Hollowspine (variant) rolls defense dice against a special attack, he adds 1 automatic shield to his defense roll.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, after all Order Markers have been revealed and resolved, Thrax Hollowspine (variant) receives 1 wound. Wounds received from Crumbling Form cannot be prevented or ignored by any special power.
design_note: The guaranteed one wound per round is a hard clock, but Soul Harvest can partly refund it, so the drawback's true cost hinges on how often he lands killing blows.

name: Kael Tessarin
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. Figures attacked by Mindshock Special Attack cannot roll any defense dice against this attack. Mindshock Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Once per turn, after moving and before attacking with Kael Tessarin, you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Kael Tessarin and move that figure 1 space. You may not move that figure to a space more than 1 level higher or lower than the space it occupied, and you may not move that figure onto a space it cannot normally occupy. A figure moved by Telekinetic Shift does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: An unblockable 2-die special attack plus free repositioning of enemies or allies gives reliable chip damage and glyph/engagement control that is hard to convert into dice math.

name: Kael Tessarin (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. Figures attacked by Mindshock Special Attack cannot roll any defense dice against this attack. Mindshock Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Once per turn, after moving and before attacking with Kael Tessarin (variant), you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces and move that figure 1 space. You may not move that figure to a space more than 1 level higher or lower than the space it occupied, and you may not move that figure onto a space it cannot normally occupy. A figure moved by Telekinetic Shift does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, and before taking a turn with Kael Tessarin (variant), roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent takes that entire turn with Kael Tessarin (variant) instead of you, using all of his powers. If there is more than one opponent, the opponent to your left takes the turn. That opponent may not move Kael Tessarin (variant) off the battlefield.
design_note: A 30% chance per revealed Order Marker of handing an unblockable attacker to the opponent is a swingy, potentially self-destructive drawback that is far worse than simply losing the turn.

name: Valgrim Ashmantle
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure adjacent to Valgrim Ashmantle. That figure, and all figures adjacent to both Valgrim Ashmantle and the chosen figure, are affected by Emberforged Cleave Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, if Valgrim Ashmantle is on a land space at least 2 levels above the attacking figure's base, add 2 dice to his defense.
design_note: A wide multi-target special attack on a 6-life, 5-attack chassis with a conditional +2 defense makes the base pair-member's fair price already contested before any drawback is applied.

name: Valgrim Ashmantle (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure adjacent to Valgrim Ashmantle. That figure, and all figures adjacent to both Valgrim Ashmantle and the chosen figure, are affected by Emberforged Cleave Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, if Valgrim Ashmantle is on a land space at least 2 levels above the attacking figure's base, add 2 dice to his defense.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, Valgrim Ashmantle must move by the shortest available path toward the figure nearest to him, friend or foe, and if he is able to attack that figure this turn he must attack it, with either a normal attack or Emberforged Cleave Special Attack. If two or more figures are equally near, you choose which of those figures he moves toward and attacks. Valgrim Ashmantle may not be given a turn in which he neither moves toward nor attacks the nearest figure.
ability_4_desc: Figures you control may be chosen and attacked by Valgrim Ashmantle as described by Ashen Frenzy, and are affected normally by Emberforged Cleave Special Attack.
design_note: Forced targeting of the nearest figure turns an area special attack into a liability near your own army, but the drawback is nearly harmless in a solo-hero build, so the discount is highly army-dependent.

name: Lysandra Orne
ability_1_desc: When Lysandra Orne rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure and receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, the attacking figure receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: Lysandra Orne is never attacked when leaving an engagement. After taking a turn with Lysandra Orne, you may move her 1 space.
ability_3_desc: When Lysandra Orne attacks an adjacent figure that is not adjacent to any other figure you control, add 1 die to her attack.
design_note: Defense 5 with a counterattack d20 and free repositioning stacks several small survivability bonuses that are easy to underrate individually and overrate together.

name: Lysandra Orne (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Lysandra Orne rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure and receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, the attacking figure receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: Lysandra Orne is never attacked when leaving an engagement. After taking a turn with Lysandra Orne, you may move her 1 space.
ability_3_desc: When Lysandra Orne attacks an adjacent figure that is not adjacent to any other figure you control, add 1 die to her attack.
ability_4_desc: At the end of every round, after all Order Markers have been revealed and all turns have been taken, place one Wound Marker on this Army Card. Wounds received from Hemorrhaging Wound cannot be prevented or ignored by any power. If this destroys Lysandra Orne, your opponents do not receive credit for destroying her for the purposes of any power that triggers on destroying a figure.
design_note: A guaranteed wound per round caps her effective lifespan at about four rounds, but a 20% self-heal that costs her attack partially offsets it, making the size of the discount genuinely unclear.

name: Sulaan the Deepcaller
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When attacking with Tide Lance Special Attack, if the defending figure is on or adjacent to a water space, roll 2 additional attack dice. Figures attacked with Tide Lance Special Attack cannot be affected by any power that ignores or prevents wounds on a 20-sided die roll.
ability_2_desc: Sulaan the Deepcaller does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces. If Sulaan the Deepcaller starts his turn on a water space, add 2 to his Move number for that turn.
design_note: Both of Sulaan's powers scale sharply with the amount of water terrain in play, so his value swings between mediocre and excellent depending on the map.

name: Sulaan the Deepcaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When attacking with Tide Lance Special Attack, if the defending figure is on or adjacent to a water space, roll 2 additional attack dice. Figures attacked with Tide Lance Special Attack cannot be affected by any power that ignores or prevents wounds on a 20-sided die roll.
ability_2_desc: Sulaan the Deepcaller does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces. If Sulaan the Deepcaller starts his turn on a water space, add 2 to his Move number for that turn.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and before taking a turn with Sulaan the Deepcaller, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent to your left takes this turn with Sulaan the Deepcaller instead of you. That opponent moves and attacks with Sulaan the Deepcaller as if he controlled this Army Card, and may attack figures you control. After that turn is finished, remove the revealed Order Marker as normal. While an opponent is taking a turn with Sulaan the Deepcaller, you may not use any power on this card to affect that turn.
design_note: A 30% chance per turn to hand a 6-life, range-6 blaster to an opponent is a catastrophic swing that is much worse than simply losing the turn, so the discount must exceed the raw 30% activation loss.

name: Ysoril Thornwarden
ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. If a figure receives one or more wounds from Brambleshot Special Attack, subtract 2 from that figure's Move number until the end of the round. A figure with a Move number of 2 or less that is wounded by Brambleshot Special Attack cannot move until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: If Ysoril Thornwarden is targeted and would receive one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, and Ysoril Thornwarden is on or adjacent to a tree space, road space of the Wellspring, or any Glacier, Jungle, or Swamp terrain space, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, ignore any wounds from that attack.
design_note: A long-range slowing special attack plus terrain-gated damage negation gives him strong board control but no damage ceiling, making him easy to price either as a utility archer or as a premium sniper.

name: Ysoril Thornwarden (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. If a figure receives one or more wounds from Brambleshot Special Attack, subtract 2 from that figure's Move number until the end of the round. A figure with a Move number of 2 or less that is wounded by Brambleshot Special Attack cannot move until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: If Ysoril Thornwarden is targeted and would receive one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, and Ysoril Thornwarden is on or adjacent to a tree space, road space of the Wellspring, or any Glacier, Jungle, or Swamp terrain space, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, ignore any wounds from that attack.
ability_3_desc: Ysoril Thornwarden cannot move and attack on the same turn. When you reveal an Order Marker on this Army Card, you must choose either to move Ysoril Thornwarden up to his Move number, or to attack with a normal attack or Brambleshot Special Attack. If Ysoril Thornwarden is moved by any power on another Army Card during a turn on this card, he cannot attack that turn.
design_note: Losing move-and-shoot hurts far less for a range-7 attacker who can camp a tree space than it would for a melee figure, so the correct discount is much smaller than the drawback's wording suggests.

name: Marrek Thal
ability_1_desc: When Marrek Thal rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if he receives no wounds from that attack, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Marrek Thal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Attack 5 with a punishing counter power on a 6-life hero sits awkwardly between mid-tier and premium melee heroes.

name: Marrek Thal (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Marrek Thal rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if he receives no wounds from that attack, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Marrek Thal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Marrek Thal and before taking his turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent takes Marrek Thal's turn this turn instead of you, moving and attacking with him as if he were his own figure. If there is more than one opponent, the opponent with the fewest figures on the battlefield takes the turn. Marrek Thal cannot be attacked by the figures of the opponent taking his turn during that turn.
design_note: A 30% chance per order marker of handing a high-attack melee hero to the enemy also wastes the order marker, so the discount must cover both lost tempo and self-inflicted damage.

name: Eranthe Highwind
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Eranthe Highwind's movement, ignore elevations. Eranthe Highwind may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Eranthe Highwind is engaged when she starts to fly, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If Eranthe Highwind moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to her normal attack.
design_note: Flying plus defense 5 and a conditional fifth attack die makes her durability and mobility hard to separate from her modest life total.

name: Eranthe Highwind (variant)
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Eranthe Highwind's movement, ignore elevations. Eranthe Highwind may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Eranthe Highwind is engaged when she starts to fly, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If Eranthe Highwind moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to her normal attack.
ability_3_desc: At the end of every round, place 1 wound marker on this Army Card. Eranthe Highwind receives this wound whether or not she took a turn that round, and this wound cannot be prevented or ignored by any power.
ability_4_desc: Eranthe Highwind cannot be healed or have wound markers removed from this Army Card by any power.
design_note: A guaranteed wound every round caps her at roughly five rounds of life regardless of her defense 5, turning a durable flyer into a timer that must be discounted steeply.

name: Grosh Ironmaw
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grosh Ironmaw are affected by Ironmaw Sweep Special Attack. Roll each defending figure's defense dice separately. Figures you control are also affected by this special attack.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, Grosh Ironmaw adds 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A sweep that also hits your own figures paired with attack 5 and only defense 3 makes his effective value swing wildly with the army built around him.

name: Grosh Ironmaw (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grosh Ironmaw are affected by Ironmaw Sweep Special Attack. Roll each defending figure's defense dice separately. Figures you control are also affected by this special attack.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, Grosh Ironmaw adds 1 die to his defense.
ability_3_desc: When Grosh Ironmaw attacks with a normal attack, he must attack the figure with the fewest clear sight spaces between it and Grosh Ironmaw, whether that figure is an opponent's figure or a figure you control. If two or more figures are equally near, an opponent chooses which of those figures Grosh Ironmaw must attack. Grosh Ironmaw must move toward the nearest figure if he is able to end his move adjacent to it.
design_note: Forced targeting of the nearest figure makes him a liability beside your own squads yet still lethal in a solo screen, so the drawback's cost depends entirely on army composition.

name: Sylvaen Duskarrow
ability_1_desc: When Sylvaen Duskarrow attacks an opponent's figure that is 3 or more spaces away, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: If Sylvaen Duskarrow did not move on his turn, you may add 1 die to his normal attack.
design_note: Range 7 with defense-shredding shots plus a stand-still bonus blurs the line between a 100-point archer and a premium sniper.

name: Sylvaen Duskarrow (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Sylvaen Duskarrow attacks an opponent's figure that is 3 or more spaces away, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: If Sylvaen Duskarrow did not move on his turn, you may add 1 die to his normal attack.
ability_3_desc: Sylvaen Duskarrow cannot move and attack on the same turn. When you reveal an Order Marker on Sylvaen Duskarrow, you must choose either to move him up to his Move value or to attack with him, but not both. Sylvaen Duskarrow may not be moved by any power you control on a turn in which he attacks.
design_note: His own Steady Aim rewards standing still, so the cannot-move-and-attack drawback is far less punishing here than it would be on a melee hero and is easy to overprice as a discount.

name: Grimhold the Unbroken
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Grimhold the Unbroken add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grimhold the Unbroken, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Grimhold the Unbroken is never moved, placed, or affected by an opponent's special power that would move him from the space he occupies.
design_note: A slow, high-defense aura anchor whose self-repair and wound-soaking both scale with how long he survives, making his real durability hard to convert into a flat cost.

name: Grimhold the Unbroken (variant)
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grimhold the Unbroken (variant), you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) is never moved, placed, or affected by an opponent's special power that would move him from the space he occupies.
ability_4_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from Grimhold the Unbroken (variant)'s Army Card. Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) cannot be healed by any special power, glyph, or other game effect.
design_note: The added drawback silently turns his own Stone Mending 14 into a dead power, so the price drop must cover both the lost external healing and a printed ability that can never trigger.

name: Kestrel Vane
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. When Kestrel Vane attacks with her Diving Volley Special Attack, she may attack 2 additional times. She may not attack the same figure more than once with Diving Volley Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: Kestrel Vane adds 1 to her Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Kestrel Vane's movement, ignore elevations. She may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Kestrel Vane is engaged when she starts to fly, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A cheap-bodied flier whose three-target special attack and flight-plus-evasion mobility give her far more board impact than her raw 4 life and Attack 3 suggest.

name: Kestrel Vane (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. When Kestrel Vane (variant) attacks with her Diving Volley Special Attack, she may attack 2 additional times. She may not attack the same figure more than once with Diving Volley Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: Kestrel Vane (variant) adds 1 to her Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Kestrel Vane (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. She may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Kestrel Vane (variant) is engaged when she starts to fly, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: While there are one or more wound markers on Kestrel Vane (variant)'s Army Card, she loses her Flying special power.
design_note: The drawback costs nothing until the first wound lands, after which her escape plan vanishes entirely, so the discount depends on how often opponents can reach her at all.

name: Ellyriel Dawnstride
ability_1_desc: While Ellyriel Dawnstride occupies a space containing a glyph, she adds 1 to her Attack Value and 1 to her Defense Value.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Elf Squad figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Ellyriel Dawnstride add 1 to their Move Value.
ability_3_desc: When Ellyriel Dawnstride rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds inflicted by that attack.
design_note: Her value swings wildly with the map, since a glyph-heavy battlefield turns her into an Attack 4 Defense 4 runner while a glyph-poor one leaves a plain Attack 3 archer.

name: Ellyriel Dawnstride (variant)
ability_1_desc: While Ellyriel Dawnstride (variant) occupies a space containing a glyph, she adds 1 to her Attack Value and 1 to her Defense Value.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Elf Squad figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Ellyriel Dawnstride (variant) add 1 to their Move Value.
ability_3_desc: When Ellyriel Dawnstride (variant) rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds inflicted by that attack.
ability_4_desc: Ellyriel Dawnstride (variant) may not pick up, carry, or use any glyphs. If she occupies a space containing a glyph, ignore that glyph's special power or effect for her, and she may not reveal or claim a Treasure Glyph.
design_note: Denying glyphs also blanks her own Waystone Attunement, stacking a lost power on top of a lost tactical option for a fast figure whose whole job is claiming glyphs.

name: Skarn Ridge Cleavers
ability_1_desc: When a Skarn Ridge Cleaver you control attacks an adjacent figure, roll 1 additional attack die if at least one other friendly Orc or Goblin figure is adjacent to the defending figure.
ability_2_desc: If a Skarn Ridge Cleaver you control destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, that Cleaver may immediately make one additional normal attack against a different adjacent figure. A Skarn Ridge Cleaver may use Cleaving Swing only once per turn.
design_note: A cheap 4-figure melee common whose damage output depends entirely on how tightly the army clumps, so its ceiling with a goblin-orc horde is far above its floor alone.

name: Skarn Ridge Cleavers (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Skarn Ridge Cleaver (variant) you control attacks an adjacent figure, roll 1 additional attack die if at least one other friendly Orc or Goblin figure is adjacent to the defending figure.
ability_2_desc: If a Skarn Ridge Cleaver (variant) you control destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, that Cleaver may immediately make one additional normal attack against a different adjacent figure. A Skarn Ridge Cleaver (variant) may use Cleaving Swing only once per turn.
ability_3_desc: If it is possible to do so, each Skarn Ridge Cleaver (variant) you control must end its movement on a space adjacent to at least one other friendly figure.
design_note: The forced clustering is nearly free for a squad that already wants to swarm, but it hands opponents easy special-attack targets, so the discount should be small and is easy to overprice.

name: Thessaly Windshear
ability_1_desc: If Thessaly Windshear used her Flying special power this turn and moved at least 4 spaces before attacking, she rolls 2 additional attack dice on her first normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Thessaly Windshear, you may choose one small or medium figure you control adjacent to Thessaly and move that figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure may not attack after moving with Windshear Escort.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Thessaly Windshear's movement, ignore elevations. Thessaly Windshear may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thessaly Windshear starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Move 7 with Flying plus a conditional +2 attack dice diving bonus and a free ally reposition stack three value sources that are hard to separate.

name: Thessaly Windshear (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Thessaly Windshear used her Flying special power this turn and moved at least 4 spaces before attacking, she rolls 2 additional attack dice on her first normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Thessaly Windshear, you may choose one small or medium figure you control adjacent to Thessaly and move that figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure may not attack after moving with Windshear Escort.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Thessaly Windshear's movement, ignore elevations. Thessaly Windshear may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thessaly Windshear starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: While there are one or more wound markers on this Army Card, Thessaly Windshear cannot use her Flying special power.
design_note: The drawback only bites after the first wound, but it also silently switches off Diving Assault, so its cost is larger than it first reads.

name: Grubhollow Sappers
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. After attacking with Sapper's Charge Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, the attacking Grubhollow Sapper receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Grubhollow Sapper's movement, that Sapper may move through spaces occupied by small or medium figures without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After a Grubhollow Sapper you control is destroyed, you may move each other Grubhollow Sapper you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
design_note: A 4-figure common squad with a self-wounding ranged special attack and free mobility tricks sits awkwardly between cheap melee chaff and real ranged squads.

name: Grubhollow Sappers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. After attacking with Sapper's Charge Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, the attacking Grubhollow Sapper receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Grubhollow Sapper's movement, that Sapper may move through spaces occupied by small or medium figures without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After a Grubhollow Sapper you control is destroyed, you may move each other Grubhollow Sapper you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
ability_4_desc: When a Grubhollow Sapper you control is engaged with 2 or more opponent's figures, subtract 1 from that Sapper's Defense Value.
design_note: Losing a die from an already thin defense of 2 matters most exactly when swarmed, which is how common squads usually die.

name: Zeroline Marksmen
ability_1_desc: When a Zeroline Marksman attacks an opponent's figure that is within 4 clear sight spaces of another Soulborg you control, that Marksman rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Zeroline Marksmen, you may move each Zeroline Marksman you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
ability_3_desc: A Zeroline Marksman that did not move this turn adds 1 to its Defense Value against normal attacks from non-adjacent figures.
design_note: Range 7 attack 3 on a three-figure unique squad with a conditional fourth attack die pushes past the usual ranged-squad ceiling.

name: Zeroline Marksmen (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Zeroline Marksman attacks an opponent's figure that is within 4 clear sight spaces of another Soulborg you control, that Marksman rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Zeroline Marksmen, you may move each Zeroline Marksman you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
ability_3_desc: A Zeroline Marksman that did not move this turn adds 1 to its Defense Value against normal attacks from non-adjacent figures.
ability_4_desc: Zeroline Marksmen may not pick up or carry any glyph, and are never affected by the powers of any glyph they occupy. Zeroline Marksmen may still move onto and stop on glyph spaces.
design_note: Glyph denial costs nothing in some builds and a whole treasure strategy in others, so its price swings with the map rather than the card.

name: Bastion Argevaine
ability_1_desc: Bastion Argevaine adds 1 to his Defense Value for each other Soldier you control adjacent to him, up to a maximum of 2 added dice.
ability_2_desc: While there is an Order Marker on this Army Card, all Soldiers you control adjacent to Bastion Argevaine add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_3_desc: After Bastion Argevaine receives one or more wounds from an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: A tank-buff-heal bundle whose defense and aura both depend on keeping a Soldier screen alive, making its real durability very army-dependent.

name: Bastion Argevaine (variant)
ability_1_desc: Bastion Argevaine adds 1 to his Defense Value for each other Soldier you control adjacent to him, up to a maximum of 2 added dice.
ability_2_desc: While there is an Order Marker on this Army Card, all Soldiers you control adjacent to Bastion Argevaine add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_3_desc: After Bastion Argevaine receives one or more wounds from an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_4_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from this Army Card by any special power or glyph, including Bastion Argevaine's own Second Wind 16 special power.
design_note: The single added drawback fully cancels one of the card's three printed powers as well as all outside healing, blurring the line between mild and severe.

name: Vaelith Stormcaller
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If Gale Lash Special Attack inflicts 1 or more wounds on a Small or Medium figure, after that attack you may move the defending figure up to 3 spaces. The defending figure will not take any leaving engagement attacks, and may not be moved to a space more than 1 level above the space it started on or into molten lava.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Kyrie adjacent to Vaelith Stormcaller add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense dice against attacks from non-adjacent figures.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Stormcaller's movement, ignore elevations. Vaelith Stormcaller may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Stormcaller starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A mid-life flyer whose push-away special attack and conditional squad aura are worth more in swarm armies than in duels, making the baseline hard to peg.

name: Vaelith Stormcaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If Gale Lash Special Attack inflicts 1 or more wounds on a Small or Medium figure, after that attack you may move the defending figure up to 3 spaces. The defending figure will not take any leaving engagement attacks, and may not be moved to a space more than 1 level above the space it started on or into molten lava.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Kyrie adjacent to Vaelith Stormcaller (variant) add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense dice against attacks from non-adjacent figures.
ability_3_desc: If there are 1 or more wound markers on this Army Card, Vaelith Stormcaller (variant) loses Flying for the rest of the game.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Stormcaller (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. Vaelith Stormcaller (variant) may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Stormcaller (variant) starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Losing Flying on the first wound strips her kiting game exactly when she needs it most, but a lucky untouched game costs her nothing.

name: Ironroot Hammerguard
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ironroot Hammerguard, if that Hammerguard is adjacent to 1 or more other Ironroot Hammerguards you control, add 1 die to his defense.
ability_2_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph, and they never roll for falling damage.
design_note: Defense 4 that becomes an effective 5 in formation on a move-4 melee squad blurs the line between a cheap wall and a premium anchor.

name: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ironroot Hammerguard (variant), if that Hammerguard is adjacent to 1 or more other Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) figures you control, add 1 die to his defense.
ability_2_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph, and they never roll for falling damage.
ability_3_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) figures may not pick up, carry, or be affected by any glyph. Treat any glyph a Hammerguard (variant) occupies as an ordinary space; that glyph's power does not activate and is not revealed by that figure.
design_note: Glyph denial costs a slow melee squad little on glyph-light maps but cripples their role as cheap glyph-sitters on tournament maps.

name: Mordrek Vyle
ability_1_desc: Each time Mordrek Vyle destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Mordrek Vyle cannot Soul Siphon destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Mordrek Vyle, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 1 Small or Medium Common Squad figure you control that has been destroyed this game and place it on an empty space adjacent to Mordrek Vyle.
ability_3_desc: Any opponent's figure that starts its turn adjacent to Mordrek Vyle subtracts 1 from its Move Value for that turn.
design_note: Self-healing plus a 30% per-turn squad resurrection can generate unbounded value in a common-squad army while doing almost nothing in a hero build.

name: Mordrek Vyle (variant)
ability_1_desc: Each time Mordrek Vyle (variant) destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Mordrek Vyle (variant) cannot Soul Siphon destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Mordrek Vyle (variant), you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 1 Small or Medium Common Squad figure you control that has been destroyed this game and place it on an empty space adjacent to Mordrek Vyle (variant).
ability_3_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from Mordrek Vyle (variant)'s Army Card by any means, including his own Soul Siphon, other special powers, and glyphs.
design_note: The drawback directly cancels one of his own printed powers, so its cost depends entirely on how often Soul Siphon would have triggered.

name: Sablewind Scouts
ability_1_desc: When a Sablewind Scout attacks an opponent's figure that is adjacent to 1 or more other friendly figures, add 1 die to that Scout's attack.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with a Unique Hero you control, you may first move 1 Sablewind Scout you control up to 3 spaces. That Scout may not attack this turn.
design_note: Range 6 attack 3 with a common conditional bonus and a free half-turn mover sits right at the ceiling for ranged squad pricing.

name: Sablewind Scouts (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Sablewind Scout (variant) attacks an opponent's figure that is adjacent to 1 or more other friendly figures, add 1 die to that Scout's attack.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with a Unique Hero you control, you may first move 1 Sablewind Scout (variant) you control up to 3 spaces. That Scout may not attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: Whenever a Sablewind Scout (variant) moves, if it is possible for that figure to end its movement on a space adjacent to another friendly figure, it must do so.
design_note: Forced clustering both fuels their own Crossfire and hands opponents easy multi-figure special attack targets on defense 2 bodies.

name: Sir Callum of Greyhold
ability_1_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. When attacking with Lance Thrust Special Attack, Sir Callum of Greyhold is not considered engaged with the figure he attacks.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Callum of Greyhold adds 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A plain tanky melee hero whose reach-2 special attack dodges engagement rules, making his defensive value easy to over- or under-rate before any aura is added.

name: Sir Callum of Greyhold (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. When attacking with Lance Thrust Special Attack, Sir Callum of Greyhold is not considered engaged with the figure he attacks.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Callum of Greyhold adds 1 die to his defense.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Sir Callum of Greyhold add 1 die to their defense. Auras named Banner of Greyhold Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: The identical knight plus a 4-space army-wide defense aura, which is worth far more alongside a cheap squad swarm than it is in a hero-heavy army, so the premium over the base card is hard to pin down.

name: Unit 7-VEX
ability_1_desc: If Unit 7-VEX did not move this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking a figure that is 5 or more spaces away from Unit 7-VEX, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
design_note: Low life but a long-range, hit-doubling sniper that only performs when it stands still, so its damage output swings wildly with terrain and map size.

name: Unit 7-VEX (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Unit 7-VEX did not move this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking a figure that is 5 or more spaces away from Unit 7-VEX, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
ability_3_desc: When a friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-VEX attacks with a normal attack, that figure adds 1 die to its attack. Auras named Firing Solution Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: An army-wide attack die granted by a figure that wants to sit still in the back line pairs perfectly with ranged squads, but the aura's 4-space leash fights against its own 7-range sniping role.

name: Sludge Hollow Marauder
ability_1_desc: If a Sludge Hollow Marauder moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: Sludge Hollow Marauders are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A 1-life common hero is nearly worthless on its own, but Disengage plus a charging attack of 4 makes it a repeatable cheap harasser you can field in multiples.

name: Sludge Hollow Marauder (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Sludge Hollow Marauder moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: Sludge Hollow Marauders are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures that begin their move within 4 clear sight spaces of a Sludge Hollow Marauder you control increase their Move Value by 1. Auras named Hollow Rush Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: Putting an army-wide move aura on a fragile common hero is the pricing trap: the aura is cheap to buy in multiples but trivially removed by one attack, so it cannot be priced like a durable aura hero.

name: Brialla Thornsong
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If a figure receives at least 1 wound from Entangling Arrow Special Attack, that figure's Move Value is 0 until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: At the start of each round, before revealing any Order Markers, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Brialla Thornsong or from any friendly Elf you control within 4 clear sight spaces of her.
design_note: Soft control and a 25%-chance heal are both hard to convert into expected damage, so her worth depends almost entirely on whether her army has wounded Elves to mend.

name: Brialla Thornsong (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If a figure receives at least 1 wound from Entangling Arrow Special Attack, that figure's Move Value is 0 until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: At the start of each round, before revealing any Order Markers, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Brialla Thornsong or from any friendly Elf you control within 4 clear sight spaces of her.
ability_3_desc: When a friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Brialla Thornsong attacks with a normal attack or a special attack, that figure adds 1 die to its attack. Auras named Thornsong Chorus Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: Her aura is unusually broad because it also boosts special attacks, which can add several dice to a single volley-style squad and inflate the card's value well past a normal attack aura.

name: Captain Orrin Halewood
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Captain Orrin Halewood always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Captain Orrin Halewood, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure must immediately end its movement. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Captain Orrin Halewood, and only once per turn.
design_note: A plain melee line-holder whose automatic shield and soft movement-lock are hard to separate from raw defense value.

name: Captain Orrin Halewood (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Captain Orrin Halewood always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Captain Orrin Halewood, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure must immediately end its movement. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Captain Orrin Halewood, and only once per turn.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Captain Orrin Halewood add 1 die to their defense. A figure may not add more than 1 die for Banner of the Halewood Guard, no matter how many friendly figures with this special power are within 4 clear sight spaces.
design_note: The unrestricted +1 defense die aura scales with however many cheap squad figures you crowd around him, so its worth depends entirely on the army built behind it.

name: Grukka Boneflail
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grukka Boneflail are affected by Flailing Onslaught Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking with Flailing Onslaught Special Attack, Grukka Boneflail receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: If there are 1 or more wound markers on Grukka Boneflail's Army Card, add 1 to Grukka Boneflail's Attack Value.
design_note: Self-wounding sweep attack combined with a wound-triggered attack bonus makes his effective damage output rise as his survivability collapses.

name: Grukka Boneflail (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grukka Boneflail are affected by Flailing Onslaught Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking with Flailing Onslaught Special Attack, Grukka Boneflail receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: If there are 1 or more wound markers on Grukka Boneflail's Army Card, add 1 to Grukka Boneflail's Attack Value.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Orc figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Grukka Boneflail add 1 die to their normal attacks. A figure may not add more than 1 die for Blood Howl Aura.
design_note: The attack aura is restricted to Orcs and requires clustering a fragile Defense 2 hero near the front line, so the offensive upside is real but conditional.

name: Sentinel Kryx-9
ability_1_desc: If Sentinel Kryx-9 did not move on his turn, add 1 to his Range Value and add 1 die to his normal attack for that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of Sentinel Kryx-9's turn, if there are 1 or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Sentinel Kryx-9's Army Card.
design_note: A low-move ranged hero whose damage is only good when he stands still, and whose 25% self-heal is worth much more in a defensive build than an aggressive one.

name: Sentinel Kryx-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Sentinel Kryx-9 did not move on his turn, add 1 to his Range Value and add 1 die to his normal attack for that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of Sentinel Kryx-9's turn, if there are 1 or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Sentinel Kryx-9's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Sentinel Kryx-9 add 1 to their Move Value. A figure may not add more than 1 to its Move Value for Tactical Uplink Aura.
design_note: A move aura granted by a Move 4 figure who wants to stay stationary is awkwardly self-conflicting, making the buff easy to overvalue.

name: Sylvan Hornblower
ability_1_desc: When a Sylvan Hornblower is attacked by a non-adjacent figure, and the Sylvan Hornblower is on a jungle space or adjacent to a tree, add 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: Before moving with a Sylvan Hornblower, you may choose a friendly Elf figure within 6 clear sight spaces of that Sylvan Hornblower. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move the chosen figure up to 3 spaces. A figure may be moved only once each turn with Signal Blast 15.
design_note: A cheap common hero with a terrain-dependent defense bump and an unreliable ally-mover, both of which can be fielded in multiples to compound.

name: Sylvan Hornblower (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Sylvan Hornblower is attacked by a non-adjacent figure, and the Sylvan Hornblower is on a jungle space or adjacent to a tree, add 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: Before moving with a Sylvan Hornblower, you may choose a friendly Elf figure within 6 clear sight spaces of that Sylvan Hornblower. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move the chosen figure up to 3 spaces. A figure may be moved only once each turn with Signal Blast 15.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of a Sylvan Hornblower add 1 to their Move Value. A figure may not add more than 1 to its Move Value for Rallying Horn Aura, no matter how many Sylvan Hornblowers are within 4 clear sight spaces.
design_note: Because this is a common hero, the aura can be purchased repeatedly for redundant coverage even though the bonus itself does not stack.

name: Halvor Steelbeard
ability_1_desc: If you did not move Halvor Steelbeard on his turn, add 2 to his Defense value until the beginning of his next turn.
ability_2_desc: After attacking an adjacent Small or Medium figure with a normal attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound and you may move it 1 space. The chosen space must be empty and may not be more than 1 level higher than the space the defending figure is on.
design_note: A tanky mid-cost melee hero whose Anvil Stance rewards not moving, making his real defense higher than the printed 4 without any aura to pay for.

name: Halvor Steelbeard (variant)
ability_1_desc: If you did not move Halvor Steelbeard on his turn, add 2 to his Defense value until the beginning of his next turn.
ability_2_desc: After attacking an adjacent Small or Medium figure with a normal attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound and you may move it 1 space. The chosen space must be empty and may not be more than 1 level higher than the space the defending figure is on.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Halvor Steelbeard add 1 die to their defense.
design_note: The added defense aura is worth very little in a small hero-only force but enormous behind a wide screen of common squads, so its price depends entirely on the army built around it.

name: Vanguard Model K-77
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. Whether or not the defending figure receives any wounds, subtract 2 from that figure's Move value until the next time you reveal an Order Marker. Suppressive Volley Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: If Vanguard Model K-77 is attacked with a normal attack by a figure that is not adjacent to him, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, Vanguard Model K-77 receives no wounds from that attack.
design_note: Range 6 with only Attack 3 plus a soft-control special attack makes the base figure's damage output unimpressive while its Defense 5 and Deflector Shield make it very hard to remove.

name: Vanguard Model K-77 (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. Whether or not the defending figure receives any wounds, subtract 2 from that figure's Move value until the next time you reveal an Order Marker. Suppressive Volley Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: If Vanguard Model K-77 is attacked with a normal attack by a figure that is not adjacent to him, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, Vanguard Model K-77 receives no wounds from that attack.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Vanguard Model K-77 add 1 die to their attack when attacking with a normal attack.
design_note: An attack-die aura on a durable long-range figure is easy to keep active all game, and it scales with the number of friendly attack rolls rather than with this hero's own stats.

name: Zurrek Broodcaller
ability_1_desc: If this Zurrek Broodcaller moved at least 4 spaces on his turn before attacking, add 1 die to his attack for the duration of that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if this Zurrek Broodcaller has one or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: Self-healing on an uncommon hero that can be fielded in multiples makes each copy better than its raw 5-life, 3-defense profile suggests.

name: Zurrek Broodcaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: If this Zurrek Broodcaller moved at least 4 spaces on his turn before attacking, add 1 die to his attack for the duration of that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if this Zurrek Broodcaller has one or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Zurrek Broodcaller add 1 to their Move value. If a figure is within 4 clear sight spaces of more than one Zurrek Broodcaller you control, it still adds only 1 to its Move value.
design_note: A move aura is the weakest of the three aura types in a vacuum, yet on an uncommon hero it can be stacked across several copies for board-wide reach even though the bonus itself does not stack.

name: Ashgrove Halberdier
ability_1_desc: If this Ashgrove Halberdier is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure that moved 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 2 dice to this Ashgrove Halberdier's defense for that attack.
ability_2_desc: When this Ashgrove Halberdier attacks a figure that is engaged with at least 1 other friendly Human figure, add 1 die to his attack.
design_note: A two-life common hero with conditional bonuses on both defense and attack is priced by how often those conditions actually trigger, which varies wildly by army.

name: Ashgrove Halberdier (variant)
ability_1_desc: If this Ashgrove Halberdier is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure that moved 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 2 dice to this Ashgrove Halberdier's defense for that attack.
ability_2_desc: When this Ashgrove Halberdier attacks a figure that is engaged with at least 1 other friendly Human figure, add 1 die to his attack.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Ashgrove Halberdier add 1 die to their defense. If a figure is within 4 clear sight spaces of more than one Ashgrove Halberdier you control, it still adds only 1 die to its defense.
design_note: Putting a faction-wide defense aura on a cheap, fragile common hero that can be fielded in multiples means the aura's value is nearly independent of the figure's own combat stats and hard to price at common-hero rates.

name: Vashri the Flamecaller
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with Vashri the Flamecaller, you may choose a non-adjacent figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Vashri and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds, and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1-7, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After using Cinderburst, if the chosen figure was destroyed, you may move Vashri the Flamecaller up to 3 spaces. Vashri may not attack after moving with Ashen Wake.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vashri's movement, ignore elevations. Vashri may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vashri starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 65% chance at a 2-wound, no-defense-dice blast with splash damage at range 5 is close to a guaranteed squad-killer each turn, so the card's worth is driven almost entirely by the threshold rather than its ordinary 4-life body.

name: Vashri the Flamecaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with Vashri the Flamecaller, you may choose a non-adjacent figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Vashri and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds, and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1-14, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After using Cinderburst, if the chosen figure was destroyed, you may move Vashri the Flamecaller up to 3 spaces. Vashri may not attack after moving with Ashen Wake.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vashri's movement, ignore elevations. Vashri may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vashri starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: At only a 30% success rate the same blast becomes a gamble you often trade away a whole turn for, but the follow-up move and flight keep some floor value, making the drop from the 8+ version hard to size.

name: Sepulcher Ghouls
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Sepulcher Ghoul you control, if the defending figure has one or more wounds on its Army Card, that Sepulcher Ghoul rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's turn, for each Sepulcher Ghoul you control that was destroyed during that turn, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, take that Sepulcher Ghoul and place it on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of another Sepulcher Ghoul you control. If you roll a 1-10, nothing happens. You may not use Rise Again if you control no Sepulcher Ghouls on the battlefield.
ability_3_desc: Sepulcher Ghouls can move through all other Undead figures you control.
design_note: Recurring half of the squad's casualties every round effectively multiplies the card's life total, so the threshold quietly decides whether this is a cheap chaff squad or a persistent board-control engine.

name: Sepulcher Ghouls (variant)
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Sepulcher Ghoul you control, if the defending figure has one or more wounds on its Army Card, that Sepulcher Ghoul rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's turn, for each Sepulcher Ghoul you control that was destroyed during that turn, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take that Sepulcher Ghoul and place it on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of another Sepulcher Ghoul you control. If you roll a 1-16, nothing happens. You may not use Rise Again if you control no Sepulcher Ghouls on the battlefield.
ability_3_desc: Sepulcher Ghouls can move through all other Undead figures you control.
design_note: At 20% the resurrection is a pleasant surprise rather than a plan, but because the roll happens for every ghoul destroyed the swarm can still generate value in large games, complicating a clean discount.

name: Unit 7-Vex
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Unit 7-Vex and before taking its turn, you may choose an opponent's Hero within 6 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, until the end of the round that Hero cannot use any of its special powers and subtracts 2 from its Move value. If you roll a 1-10, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's figure ends its movement within 5 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, that figure receives 1 wound. You may use Reactive Fire only once each round.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Unit 7-Vex, if it did not attack this turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from Unit 7-Vex's Army Card.
design_note: Shutting off an enemy Hero's special powers for a round is an effect with no fixed damage value, so its price swings wildly depending on whether the 50% roll lands often enough to be a reliable answer to big Heroes.

name: Unit 7-Vex (variant)
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Unit 7-Vex and before taking its turn, you may choose an opponent's Hero within 6 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, until the end of the round that Hero cannot use any of its special powers and subtracts 2 from its Move value. If you roll a 1-16, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's figure ends its movement within 5 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, that figure receives 1 wound. You may use Reactive Fire only once each round.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Unit 7-Vex, if it did not attack this turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from Unit 7-Vex's Army Card.
design_note: Because the pulse costs nothing but a die roll before a normal turn, even a 20% hit rate is pure upside, which means the variant should lose far less value than the raw odds suggest.

name: Ironhold Shieldbearers
ability_1_desc: When an Ironhold Shieldbearer you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, one shield will block all damage from that attack. If you roll a 1-7, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Ironhold Shieldbearers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Dwarf Hero you control.
ability_3_desc: All figures you control adjacent to an Ironhold Shieldbearer add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Bonding plus a 65% chance to turn a single shield into full damage prevention stacks two of the strongest value multipliers in the game onto a three-figure squad, making the threshold nearly the whole price.

name: Ironhold Shieldbearers (variant)
ability_1_desc: When an Ironhold Shieldbearer you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, one shield will block all damage from that attack. If you roll a 1-14, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Ironhold Shieldbearers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Dwarf Hero you control.
ability_3_desc: All figures you control adjacent to an Ironhold Shieldbearer add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: With only a 30% save the squad's survivability leans back on 3 defense and Bulwark, but the bonding and aura keep the card competitive, so the correct gap between the twins is smaller than the odds difference implies.

name: Sylvani Thornwhisper
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sylvani Thornwhisper, you may choose an opponent's figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sylvani and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure may not move until the end of the round. A figure affected by Bramble Snare cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
ability_2_desc: Sylvani Thornwhisper may move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A 65%-reliable no-move lockdown on any figure within 4 spaces is close to a soft Cyberclaw on demand, so the threshold does most of the pricing work here.

name: Sylvani Thornwhisper (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sylvani Thornwhisper, you may choose an opponent's figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sylvani and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure may not move until the end of the round. A figure affected by Bramble Snare cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
ability_2_desc: Sylvani Thornwhisper may move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: At 30% success the snare becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, so the card must be priced nearer to its mediocre melee stat line.

name: Grubnak Bogstalkers
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with a Grubnak Bogstalker, you may choose an opponent's small or medium figure within 5 clear sight spaces of that Bogstalker and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the chosen figure may not move or be moved until the end of the round. Only one figure may be chosen for Paralyzing Spittle each turn.
ability_2_desc: Grubnak Bogstalkers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: Trading a weak 2-attack shot for a 50% chance to strand an enemy hero across the board is hard to value against a plain Range 5 Attack 2 common squad.

name: Grubnak Bogstalkers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with a Grubnak Bogstalker, you may choose an opponent's small or medium figure within 5 clear sight spaces of that Bogstalker and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the chosen figure may not move or be moved until the end of the round. Only one figure may be chosen for Paralyzing Spittle each turn.
ability_2_desc: Grubnak Bogstalkers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: A 20% spittle is almost never worth giving up an attack die roll, so the squad prices as a bare-bones ranged common with a novelty power.

name: Overseer Tallow-9
ability_1_desc: At the start of the round, after rolling for initiative, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker from an Army Card you control and place it on another Army Card you control. You may not place more than 3 Order Markers on the same Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Any Unique Soulborg you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Overseer Tallow-9 adds 1 to its Range Value.
design_note: Order-marker manipulation is one of the strongest effects in the game, so the gap between a 65% and a 30% Recalibrate swings the price far more than the shared stat line suggests.

name: Overseer Tallow-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: At the start of the round, after rolling for initiative, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker from an Army Card you control and place it on another Army Card you control. You may not place more than 3 Order Markers on the same Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Any Unique Soulborg you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Overseer Tallow-9 adds 1 to its Range Value.
design_note: With only a 30% chance per round the marker fix is a lucky bailout, leaving a solid but unspectacular Range 6 hero with a small Soulborg aura.

name: Hearthguard of Kandras
ability_1_desc: If a Hearthguard of Kandras would be destroyed by an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that Hearthguard is not destroyed and you ignore all wounds from that attack. You may roll for Oath of Return only once for each Hearthguard of Kandras figure each round.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Hearthguard of Kandras adds 1 die for each other Hearthguard of Kandras adjacent to it.
design_note: Effectively doubling the survivability of three Defense 4 squad figures stacks multiplicatively with Shield Wall, which makes the 11+ version much stronger than a simple dice comparison implies.

name: Hearthguard of Kandras (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Hearthguard of Kandras would be destroyed by an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that Hearthguard is not destroyed and you ignore all wounds from that attack. You may roll for Oath of Return only once for each Hearthguard of Kandras figure each round.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Hearthguard of Kandras adds 1 die for each other Hearthguard of Kandras adjacent to it.
design_note: A 20% save only rarely changes an engagement, so this version must be priced mostly on three tough but slow Attack 3 melee figures.

name: Tholgrin Anvilbreaker
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Tholgrin Anvilbreaker, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound and you may then place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Tholgrin that is not more than 1 level higher than the space it occupied. Tholgrin may still attack normally this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Tholgrin Anvilbreaker rolls defense dice against an adjacent attacking figure's normal attack, if he rolls more shields than the attacking figure rolls skulls, the attacking figure receives one wound. Counter Strike does not affect Destructible Objects.
design_note: Anvil Smash at 8+ is a near-reliable free wound plus repositioning stapled onto solid 5-life melee stats, so the pair's value hinges almost entirely on how often the d20 succeeds.

name: Tholgrin Anvilbreaker (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Tholgrin Anvilbreaker, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound and you may then place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Tholgrin that is not more than 1 level higher than the space it occupied. Tholgrin may still attack normally this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Tholgrin Anvilbreaker rolls defense dice against an adjacent attacking figure's normal attack, if he rolls more shields than the attacking figure rolls skulls, the attacking figure receives one wound. Counter Strike does not affect Destructible Objects.
design_note: At 15+ the smash becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, leaving a vanilla 5-life melee hero whose price must sit far below its twin.

name: Marro Spitterlings
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Marro Spitterling, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that same Marro Spitterling. A Marro Spitterling may attack only one additional time each turn with Hive Frenzy.
ability_2_desc: When a Marro Spitterling is on a swamp water space, add 2 to its Defense Value. A Marro Spitterling does not have to stop its movement when entering a swamp water space.
design_note: A 50% chance of a second range 4 attack on each of four figures roughly acts as a half-strength double attack squad, which is hard to price against ordinary ranged commons.

name: Marro Spitterlings (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Marro Spitterling, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that same Marro Spitterling. A Marro Spitterling may attack only one additional time each turn with Hive Frenzy.
ability_2_desc: When a Marro Spitterling is on a swamp water space, add 2 to its Defense Value. A Marro Spitterling does not have to stop its movement when entering a swamp water space.
design_note: With only a 20% frenzy chance the squad is close to a bare attack 2 defense 2 ranged common, so the pair tests how steeply extra-attack odds should be discounted.

name: Stormlance Vanguard
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Stormlance Vanguard who moved at least 4 spaces this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, add 2 dice to that figure's attack for its normal attack this turn. Roll the 20-sided die separately for each Stormlance Vanguard figure taking a normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Stormlance Vanguard's movement, ignore elevations. A Stormlance Vanguard may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Stormlance Vanguard starts to fly, if it is engaged, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying melee squad figures that each average about a 1-die attack bonus at 11+ blur the line between a 3-attack and a 4-attack unique squad.

name: Stormlance Vanguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Stormlance Vanguard who moved at least 4 spaces this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, add 2 dice to that figure's attack for its normal attack this turn. Roll the 20-sided die separately for each Stormlance Vanguard figure taking a normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Stormlance Vanguard's movement, ignore elevations. A Stormlance Vanguard may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Stormlance Vanguard starts to fly, if it is engaged, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: At 17+ the charge is a rare spike, so the card is priced mostly on flying move 6 melee bodies and must be cheap enough to show the threshold gap.

name: Ashmane Prowler
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmane Prowler, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, this Ashmane Prowler may move up to 4 additional spaces and add 1 die to its attack this turn. If you roll a 1, this Ashmane Prowler cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Add 1 to the Attack Value of each Ashmane Prowler you control who is adjacent to at least one other Ashmane Prowler you control.
design_note: An uncommon hero that can stack Pack Hunter with a frequently-successful pounce scales superlinearly as you buy more copies, making the single-card price ambiguous.

name: Ashmane Prowler (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmane Prowler, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, this Ashmane Prowler may move up to 4 additional spaces and add 1 die to its attack this turn. If you roll a 1, this Ashmane Prowler cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Add 1 to the Attack Value of each Ashmane Prowler you control who is adjacent to at least one other Ashmane Prowler you control.
design_note: The same 1-in-20 whiff penalty now sits alongside only a 30% success rate, so the drawback eats into the power's value and the price should drop noticeably.

name: Halberdiers of Kinsguard
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Choose up to 2 figures adjacent to the attacking Halberdier of Kinsguard. All chosen figures are affected by Halberd Sweep Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent Large or Huge figure, that Halberdier adds 2 to its Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked, add 1 to its Defense Value if it is adjacent to at least one other Halberdier of Kinsguard you control.
design_note: A cheap-looking melee common squad whose sweep attack, anti-big bonus, and formation defense all compound only when the figures are allowed to hold ground.

name: Halberdiers of Kinsguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Choose up to 2 figures adjacent to the attacking Halberdier of Kinsguard. All chosen figures are affected by Halberd Sweep Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent Large or Huge figure, that Halberdier adds 2 to its Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked, add 1 to its Defense Value if it is adjacent to at least one other Halberdier of Kinsguard you control.
ability_4_desc: When you take a turn with the Halberdiers of Kinsguard (variant), each Halberdier you control must move its full Move Value if possible, and every space it enters must be closer to the nearest opponent's figure than the space it just left. If a Halberdier cannot move closer to the nearest opponent's figure, that Halberdier does not move.
design_note: The forced advance guarantees the squad breaks its own adjacency formation and walks into enemy range, so the drawback erases much of the defensive value while leaving the offense intact.

name: Mekaneth Pulse Troopers
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Soulborg Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper attacks a figure that is at least 4 spaces away, that Trooper rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_3_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control attacks a figure that is in the line of sight of another Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
design_note: Range 6 with attack 3 plus two stacking accuracy powers and hero bonding puts this near the top of the ranged-squad band, making the twin's lost bonding hard to subtract cleanly.

name: Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Soulborg Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper attacks a figure that is at least 4 spaces away, that Trooper rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_3_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control attacks a figure that is in the line of sight of another Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_4_desc: The Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant) cannot be bonded with. No bonding power on any Army Card, including their own Soulborg Command Bonding, may be used to take a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant), and they may not be used to take a turn with any other Army Card.
design_note: The drawback leaves a dead printed bonding power on the card, so its cost must reflect pure order-marker efficiency loss rather than any stat change.

name: Blightfang Broodlings
